units.source_text: 要说这缘故，就因为这二三年来，京都是接连的起了地动，旋风，大火，饥馑等等的灾变，所以都中便格外的荒凉了。

en.t: To explain the reason, in the past two or three years Kyoto had been struck one after another by earthquakes, whirlwinds, great fires, famines, and other calamities, so the capital had become especially desolate.

units.source_text: 据旧记说，还将佛象和佛具打碎了，

en.t: According to old records, even Buddhist statues and ritual implements were smashed apart,

units.source_text: 那些带着丹漆，带着金银箔的木块，都堆在路旁当柴卖。

en.t: and the pieces of wood, still bearing vermilion lacquer and gold or silver leaf, were all piled beside the road and sold as firewood.

units.source_text: 都中既是这情形，修理罗生门之类的事，自然再没有人过问了。

en.t: With the whole capital in such a state, naturally no one paid any attention anymore to matters like repairing the Rashomon gate.

units.source_text: 于是趁了这荒凉的好机会，狐狸来住，强盗来住；

en.t: Taking advantage of this desolation, foxes came to live there, and robbers came to live there too;

units.source_text: 到后来，且至于生出将无主的死尸弃在这门上的习惯来。

en.t: Before long, a custom even arose of abandoning unclaimed corpses on top of this gate.

units.source_text: 于是太阳一落，人们便都觉得阴气，谁也不再在这门的左近走。

en.t: So once the sun went down, everyone felt an eerie chill, and no one walked near this gate anymore.
